beats.say: A $5 razor that never stops charging you.
Buy the razor alone, no blades included.
Buy the razor with a few starter blades.
Buy the razor with a full year's supply of blades.
First-year sales look tiny. Looks like a mistake.
But it forces you to keep buying blades.
The razor itself is a one-time $5 purchase.
All the real money comes from the blades you must replace.
In the second year Gillette sold 90,884 razors, creating millions of blade customers.
You see it at coffee shops: a $3 cup, a $3 refill pack, and a $3 unlimited brew subscription - the subscription feels like a smart deal.
You see it at gyms: $20 membership, $20 membership plus one towel, $20 membership plus a monthly protein shake pack for $25 - the recurring pack wins.
Check the first purchase; the real profit hides in the consumables. Follow for more.
